_doc: NONASK-1103 E1: plain-language labels for the evidence trace (vera/evidence_trace.py). No numbers and no thresholds. A missing or invalid file means NO trace is built (fail closed, never raw codes). DB-table target is owner-gated DDL.

not_matching.text: did not match the question closely enough

not_cited.removed_by_check: the sentence that used it did not pass the citation check
not_cited.unused: the answer did not use this passage

by_refusal.model_insufficient: selected, but judged not to answer the question
by_refusal.nonresponsive: selected, but the claims drawn from it did not answer the question
by_refusal.claim_check_insufficient: selected, but its claims did not pass the citation check
by_refusal.no_valid_citations: selected, but no citation to it could be confirmed
by_refusal.insufficient_full_document_evidence: selected, but the evidence as a whole was not enough to answer
by_refusal.checker_unavailable: selected, but the citation check could not be completed
by_refusal.claim_check_disabled: selected, but the citation check was not available

refusal_other: selected, but no answer could be written from it

epistemic.reported: reported by the source, not independently verified
